text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of CreateTO under Part H, Section 22, of the Board of Directors of CreateTO By-law No. 1-2018 for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Elected Sandra Levy as Vice Chair of the Board of Directors of CreateTO for a term of office ending December 31, 2024, and until a successor is appointed.
